messages:
Priya: quick brief — we want a compact bench narrative for the launch email + a short follow-up webinar. Target: dev signups + qualified demo leads. Keep it simple: 3 visuals, 2 CTAs, one clear claim.

Dylan: claim idea: 'Know your token bill ahead of time' — focuses on predictability without sounding like a deep technical paper. Hero must be <= 6 words.

Marta: visuals: 1) frontier chart: cost vs median latency (hosted vs dedicated) with a small shaded region showing tradeoffs, 2) cache lift: percent token savings over time (stacked area), 3) tail risk: p95/p99 bars with/without batching. Each gets a one-line takeaway.

Owen: routing: two funnels — developer sandbox (fast) and performance review (for platform/enterprise). Use email domain to suggest the funnel but always let user pick. Capture company size and interest in Dedicated. Use UTMs: utm_source=bench_launch, utm_variant=postcard_A/B.

Priya: subject A: 'Know your token bill before it arrives' B: 'Shrink inference surprises' — A/B test both. Open rate target 28% for first send.

Dylan: include a tiny animated GIF for batching showing tokens collapsing into a batch (3s). Otherwise static PNGs. Add small modal on landing page where engineers can paste a quick prompt to get a sandbox run (serverless demo).

Marta: copy snippets for email: opener line, 3 bullets (what we measured; typical savings; tail impact), CTA buttons: 'Run a 5-min sandbox' and 'Request a perf review'. Keep body < 120 words.

Owen: forms: HS_FORM_SANDBOX and HS_FORM_PERF placeholders. If corporate domain and user checks "Request perf review" -> route to SDR queue with company size tag. Personal domains go to sandbox path by default.

Dylan: requested eng numbers: hosted vs dedicated CSV + quantized profile (4-bit) + typical prompt mix. Need these by Tue noon. Will ping #eng-ml.

Priya: legal note: any customer quote must be pre-approved. Use anonymized metrics if necessary: 'Beta users saw >30% token spend reduction' with source link.

Owen: tracking: click->landing->form completion, webinar signups, demo-book rate. Add hidden field campaign_id=camp_8811. Map UTMs to GA and HubSpot.

marketing-bot: Campaign created (id=camp_8811). Assets: https://drive.redwood/bench-launch-8811. Test send scheduled for 2024-10-14T16:00:00Z.

Marta: timeline ok? Priya: draft by Fri, design Monday, eng numbers Wed, internal review Tue next week, send Thurs.

Priya: final item  include a 3-line code sample for quick testing in the email fold:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":50}'
```

Dylan: good. I'll stub the landing page logic and wire UTMs. Ping me when CSV is in the drive.

Priya: thanks team  keep claims tight and cite the benchmark doc. tagging @Owen for form ids when ready. :sparkles:
